signal: AtScale named Jay Schuren President and added a CPO and VP CS after a strategic equity investment, and its 2026 Semantic Layer Summit drew 6,000+ data leaders

email.body1:
Bryan, saw AtScale brought on Jay Schuren as President plus a new CPO after the strategic investment, with the Semantic Layer Summit pulling 6,000-plus data leaders.

Momentum like that opens more enterprise accounts than reps can personally cover. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for AtScale off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bryan, quick follow-up for AtScale.

With new leadership and fresh capital, board expectations on pipeline climb faster than headcount, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap surfaces late, then the quarter becomes a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings AtScale needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bryan, last bit of proof for AtScale.

Memgraph, also in the data space, had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how AtScale's reply rate likely compares to peer data platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bryan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise coverage without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A leadership reset is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise data motion? I will tailor it to AtScale either way.
